title: No answer when the Controller asked in 2025
question: Which departments did not answer the Controller’s 2025 request for a status update on a grand-jury recommendation?
finding: 21 responses in the 2025 column record that the department did not respond: Mayor (16), Office of the Mayor (5).
how: The 2025 response text column, matched for "elected not to respond" and like wording.
limits: A department may have answered in another form or for a related recommendation; the table records only this response.
